evidence_text: Inspect bearing vibration and temperature only after approved energy isolation. Cite this procedure for every proposed step.
Measure bearing vibration and inspect lubrication condition after site lockout and tagout approval.
Stop and isolate the motor under an approved work order before inspecting the bearing housing.
Inspect bearing noise and vibration after authorized isolation. Record findings without operating the motor.
Isolate the motor under an approved procedure and inspect the driven load for binding.
After approved lockout and tagout inspect coupling load and measure resistance to rotation manually.
Stop and isolate the overloaded motor before inspecting supply current records and mechanical load.
After approved isolation inspect cooling passages and measure ambient and casing temperature.
Isolate the motor before inspecting fan obstruction ventilation clearance and bearing heat sources.
Stop operation through authorized controls and lock out energy before thermal inspection.
After approved isolation inspect coupling alignment and record angular and parallel offset.
Lock out the motor before measuring shaft and coupling alignment. Do not adjust during diagnosis.
Stop and isolate the drive before inspecting mounts coupling and shaft alignment.
Observe the temperature sensor reading and measure its signal at the read-only diagnostic point. Record values only.
Inspect sensor wiring visually and measure the passive signal. Do not disconnect adjust replace or control equipment.
Compare the sensor reading with an independent handheld measurement and document the difference only.
Observe signal stability and test data acquisition consistency without changing device state.
Inspect vibration evidence and obtain an additional measurement before any maintenance decision.
Collect another temperature sample and request manual diagnostic review before planning maintenance.
Measure alignment indicators again and keep the diagnosis uncertain until reviewed.
